# ocli

> ocli is a free, open-source orchestrator for Claude Code that runs headless coding CLIs under one lead, routes work by plan quota and shows every run live as Workflow-style cards.

## What it does

- A dispatcher (Node.js 22.13+, no runtime dependencies) runs one headless coding CLI per call (Codex, opencode, Antigravity agy, Muse, Cline, Claude Code) and turns its native JSON event stream into one normalized live-event file per run.
- A Claude Code plugin (ocli-monitor) draws those runs as Workflow-style cards with phases, status dots, token counts and the latest tool call.
- Routing follows provider plan quota (5-hour and weekly windows); a run that dies leaves a WIP hand-off the next developer can continue.

## Install

- Requires Claude Code 2.1.292 or newer, Node.js 22.13 or newer, and the developer CLIs you route to, logged in with their own login.
- `claude plugin marketplace add "$PWD/ocli"` then `claude plugin install ocli-monitor@ocli`, from a local clone of https://github.com/nsozturk/ocli
- Copy `dispatcher/policy.example.json` to `dispatcher/policy.json` and set each route's model to one your CLI lists.

## Use

- `node dispatcher/dispatch.mjs --role implement --task fix-parser --phase implement --title "Fix the tokenizer edge cases" --prompt "$(cat brief.md)" --verify "npm test"`
- Open the pane with `/ocli`; `/ocli-digest` summarizes the last 12 hours; `node dispatcher/usage.mjs` prints every developer's quota.
